_about: Methodology one-at-a-time sweep around the inferior-wall reference (FM-17). Each variable takes each of its planned values in config/model.json alone. 'roof' is the second region (FM-08): wall 1.6 mm (Whitaker et al. 2021), uniform fibres (Pashakhanloo et al. 2016). Deferred by the agreed drop order: Latin hypercube sampling, curvature, dense virtual array.
